verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline with its date/address block and the striped image beside it, so the original's two-column structure still reads well. But the whole group sits centred with large dead margins on both sides, and the image no longer bleeds off the right edge as it does in the original. B breaks the headline away from the date/address: the event details are small, floating to the right of a centred image, so the reading order runs headline, image, details and the info looks orphaned. B also leaves an empty band above and below the headline.
